dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Giants (6-3-1) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Colts
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: TE Isaiah Likely (groin) and LB Arvell Reese (back) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [giants.com Official](https://www.giants.com/news/injury-report-statuses-for-giants-vs-colts). LB Abdul Carter (ankle / calf), DT Shelby Harris (illness), and CB Dru Phillips (illness) did not practice Wednesday, while S Jevon Holland (elbow) practiced in full [Ed Valentine](https://www.bigblueview.com/new-york-giants-injuries/181478/abdul-carter-should-be-fine-despite-missing-practice).

Week 12 Colts Outlook: John Harbaugh and DC Dennard Wilson open installation for the Indianapolis Colts (3-8, NYG -6, HC Shane Steichen, OC Jim Bob Cooter & DC Lou Anarumo (Road Test))—a unit ranked #5 in Kickoff Return Average (27.5 yds) as New York prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873088) [David Fucillo](https://www.bigblueview.com/new-york-giants-odds/181414/giants-vs-colts-predictions-week-12-picks).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-3-1 (1st in NFC East • #3 Seed in NFC), New York carries a 72.9% postseason projection, 71% NFC East division title mark, and 1.6% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-cam-skattebo-brandon-aiyuk-joe-milton-commanders-eagles-giants/).
Around the Beat: NFL rookie rankings: Highest-graded players after Week 10 [Pro Football Focus](https://www.pff.com/news/nfl-rookie-rankings/).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, New York ranks #14 in Points / Game (22.6), #12 in Points Allowed / Game (21.4), #21 in Turnover Differential (-1), giving John Harbaugh and Dennard Wilson a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:00 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Indianapolis Colts [giants.com Official](https://www.giants.com/photos/practice-photos-giants-gear-up-for-colts-x1891).
